milestones.description: Uses inventory_has to check that the player has obtained spruce_leaves in their inventory. Mining spruce leaves with shears drops the leaf block as an item, which ends up in the player's inventory. This is the most direct check for a mining task. The player starts with shears but no spruce_leaves, so finding spruce_leaves in inventory confirms successful mining.

Uses inventory_has to check that the player has crafted melon_seeds. The recipe is 1 melon_slice → 1 melon_seeds (works in 2x2 inventory grid). The player starts with melon slices but no melon seeds, so finding melon_seeds in inventory confirms the craft was completed. inventory_has is preferred because the crafted item ends up in inventory and is not in starting inventory.

Uses inventory_has to check that the player has crafted a golden_axe. The recipe requires 3 gold ingots and 2 sticks arranged in the 3x3 crafting table grid. The player starts with exactly these materials and a nearby crafting table but no golden_axe, so finding golden_axe in inventory confirms successful crafting. inventory_has is the preferred rule for craft tasks.
